settings.language.note.zh-Hans: 语言设置目前覆盖设置窗口本身；主窗口与转换提示仍为中文，会在后续版本逐步切换。
settings.language.note.en: This language setting covers the Settings window itself. The main window and conversion messages are still Chinese; they will follow in a later version.

settings.revealWhenDone.zh-Hans: 完成后在 Finder 中显示结果
settings.revealWhenDone.en: Show Results in Finder When Done

settings.generalFooter.zh-Hans: 自动会按本机 CPU 核心数选择；Office 转换最多同时 3 个。输出盘可用空间低于 2 GB 时自动暂停。检查更新只向 GitHub 查询最新版本号，不发送任何文件或使用数据；自动检查默认关闭，开启后每天最多一次。
settings.generalFooter.en: Automatic picks a number from this machine's CPU cores; Office conversions run at most 3 at a time. A conversion pauses when the output disk has less than 2 GB free. Update checks ask GitHub for the latest version number only and send no files or usage data; the automatic check is off by default and runs at most once a day when enabled.

feedback.footer.zh-Hans: 反馈会在浏览器中打开 GitHub 预填表单，由你检查后提交；应用不保存令牌，不自动上传文件或日志。
feedback.footer.en: Feedback opens a pre-filled GitHub form in your browser, and you check it before submitting. The app stores no token and never uploads files or logs on its own.

about.processingValue.en: Entirely on this Mac, no uploads

about.footer.zh-Hans: 内置 LibreOffice、独立 Python 与开源转换组件，各自保留原许可证。OCR、PDF 转可编辑 Office、音视频处理属于后续规划。
about.footer.en: Bundles LibreOffice, a private Python runtime and open-source conversion components, each under its own license. OCR, PDF-to-editable-Office and audio/video work are planned for later versions.

about.openDocs.zh-Hans: 打开使用说明与许可证
